# LinkShift.app - Redirect rules, link-maps, and domain-group routing

> Public product and knowledge pages for LinkShift.app. The platform is focused on domain and path redirection, hierarchical redirect rules, link-maps (key -> destination), and analytics for redirect traffic.

## Product Facts (Public)
- Redirect rules support path match (`exact`, `prefix`) and query match (`exact`, `ignore`, `subset`).
- Rule execution is ordered by priority (higher first), then by `createdAt` (newer first).
- Link-maps support keys with optional query matching modes (`ignore`, `exact`, `subset`) and fallback destinations.
- Redirect analytics track rule hits and request context.
- Custom domains are served over HTTPS after domain setup.
